description: This file defines a React component for a user settings page in a Next.js application. It features account information, password reset functionality via Supabase, theme preview toggles, and placeholders for account deletion.

methods.name: SettingsPage
methods.description: Main React component rendering the user settings interface, including account info, password reset, theme preview, and danger zone sections.

methods.name: handleSendPasswordReset
methods.description: Handles the password reset process by invoking Supabase's resetPasswordForEmail method and managing UI state.
